task.target: NVD-authored CVSSv3.1 assessment present in current snapshot

input_units.batch_size: records from same assigning source and publication day

task.timing_contract: All covariates are snapshot-available contemporaneous metadata. Source-day count and CNA assessment may be added after initial disclosure. This is current coverage diagnostics, not prediction of future NVD action or security exploitation.
task.calibration: Whole CNA/source group folds and held sources; no held-source target calibration.
task.independent_unit: CVE records nested in complete assigning sources; duplicated JSON/gzip representations linked. Source-day batches dependent.
task.scope_limits: August23,2026 recent-feed snapshot only. Source status code is excluded; CVSS score formula and severity are not predicted. NIST policy deprioritizes duplicate scoring, so absence is not unsafe analysis failure.
task.source_license: U.S. Government work; see NVD data-use policy

exposure.schema: Native schema inspected and source-public aggregate descriptions known; case10 status counts were inspected, not new endpoint NVD-score presence scores. No reserved individual target metric printed.

task.uncertainty_policy: Whole-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or manufactured independent-population confidence. Confirmation becomes exposed after freeze.

selection: Minimize group-balanced primary error; prefer fewer coefficients within1percent of minimum; baseline may win.
stopping: At least5distinct scientific hypotheses, adaptive to development evidence; stop after2consecutive substantive attempts without accuracy/robustness/interpretation gain.
